claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, CGS-15943 is a nonselective adenosine receptor antagonist with no expected cytotoxic mechanism; any antiproliferative effect would likely be weak and non-selective, possibly reflecting adenosine-receptor-independent off-target activity rather than a defined cytotoxic class effect.
